name: Message checks
description: Placeholders, ICU syntax, text length and punctuation.

rules.title: {count} values lost or added a placeholder
rules.message: A translation has to keep the placeholders of the base locale. Fix these values.
rules.passMessage: The values of {locale} use the same placeholders as {baseLocale}.

rules.description: Plural and select messages are valid.
rules.title: {count} values are invalid messages
rules.message: Braces have to match, and a plural or select message needs an other case.
rules.passMessage: No key of {locale} uses an invalid plural or select message.

rules.description: A translation is over 150% of the length of the base locale.
rules.title: {count} values are much longer than the base locale
rules.message: Check them in the layout, or allow them.
rules.passMessage: No value of {locale} is over 150% of the length of {baseLocale}.

rules.description: Final punctuation matches the base locale.
rules.title: {count} values end differently from the base locale
rules.message: A sentence and its translation should end with the same punctuation.
rules.passMessage: The values of {locale} end with the same punctuation as {baseLocale}.
